description: Standards Control Plane shared Renovate preset. Adopters extend this preset (pinned by tag, e.g. `github>jrnb2024/standards-control-plane//renovate/default#renovate/v1.0.0`) to receive automatic pin-bumps on every SCP federation primitive release. Trust boundary: this preset is administered via the Mend-hosted Renovate Bot installed on the jrnb2024 user account; preset changes route through CODEOWNERS @jrnb2024 review. The preset extends Mend's `config:recommended` which is a floating reference whose behaviour may change without a preset bump on this side; the explicit `automerge: false` at root + per-package layers defends against silent flips of that setting. Adopters MUST NOT add packageRules that override the SCP federation primitive's automerge=false; release-notes URLs in PR bodies are mutable and advisory only (the commit SHA in the wrapper `uses:` line is the authoritative reference).

packageRules.description: SCP federation primitive — group rc + GA bumps under one PR series. ignoreUnstable=false here is the explicit per-package opt-in: adopters DO want rc.N proposals so they can canary in advance of GA. Default at root is ignoreUnstable=true — only this primitive is exempt. automerge=false is asserted at this layer too so any adopter packageRules override of the parent default is countered: a later overriding rule would have to NAME this packageRule key to flip automerge, which is loud.
prBodyNotes: This bump cascades the pinned commit SHA on the SCP self-dogfood wrapper (`.github/workflows/policy-check-wrapper.yml`) — and any caller wrapper using the canonical Renovate marker — to the latest SCP release.
The pin is a 40-char commit SHA per WP-SCP-020 020B(v) (adopters MUST pin by SHA). The comment-tag `# tag: <semver>` is auto-updated alongside the SHA.

**Authoritative reference:** the commit SHA in the `uses:` line. Release notes (linked below) are mutable post-publication; verify any contested claim against the commit at the SHA, not the release notes.

packageRules.description: Auth-SDK exclusion: `@control-tower/auth` (TS) + `ct_auth` (Python) packages are pinned by PLAN-AUTH-FOUNDATION-007 Phase 1C canonical SDK versions (9-package suite at 1.0.0). Adopter Renovate bumps must NOT auto-propose updates to these packages during the PLAN-AUTH-FOUNDATION-007 in-flight window (Phase 0 ratification → Phase 4 deny-flip ~Week 41). Remove after 9-package 1.0.0 suite published — see CT plans/PLAN-AUTH-FOUNDATION-007.md once ratified to canonical location.

customManagers.description: SCP wrapper pin: pick up the canonical adopter wrapper marker and bump both the @<commit-SHA> digest AND the `# tag: <semver>` comment together.
